task_description: Write comprehensive feature specification documents for the OCCM Groups feature in Mastodon. Includes main spec (docs/occm_groups_spec.md) and migration/rollback plan (docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md). These are design documents grounded in actual Mastodon codebase patterns, not code implementation.

verification.summary: Documentation-only task. Both spec documents created, verified, and updated per review feedback. Review fixes applied: (1) removed push_to_home contradiction, (2) added limited-visibility discriminator documentation, (3) added server-admin escalation path, (4) added counter cache reconciliation worker, (5) replaced hardcoded GROUP_VISIBILITY constant with runtime lookup, (6) unified route definitions between spec and migration plan, (7) added pagination parameters to member/report list endpoints, (8) added serializer N+1 preloading pattern.
